notes:
Lead: CTO Mateo Ruiz. Product lead: Lina Gomez. 

Summary: Meridian builds an IDE copilot plugin used by internal dev teams and enterprise customers (two-sided). Primary concern is reproducible code completion across releases — need to pin model version + inference config (quantization profile, kernel hints) so customer-facing completions don't regress after upstream model updates. Interested in a rollout model with canaries + automatic eval gates tied to a curated prompt set.

Requirements (shorthand):
- Latency SLO: 95th <= 80ms for single-line completions; streaming start < 50ms for initial tokens.
- Throughput: baseline 120 reqs/sec per region, ability to burst to 400 with autoscale.
- Cost sensitivity: high for public cloud; want optimize suggestions for batching/caching to reduce per-token cost.
- Reproducibility: deterministic outputs for pinned model+config, ability to snapshot model+quantize profile for audits.
- Rollouts: need canary (5-10% traffic) then eval gate that runs 1k prompts across codebases and checks for functional/regression deltas before promoting.
- Fallback policy: automatic fallback to last-known-good model if metric drift > thresholds.

Notes from calls:
- "We can't ship regressed completions to customers — even small semantic changes break CI flows." — Mateo (CTO).
- Priya demo: showed model pin API, rollout_control, and eval webhook; Meridian team liked the eval-gate idea but asked for more flexible metric hooks.
- Action item: SE to provide sample eval harness + baseline prompts (drive:/evals/meridian-prompt-set-v1.json).
- Security asks: SSO/SAML, KMS integration for key rotation, audit log retention 2 years, data residency preference (NA only) for enterprise customers.

POC plan: 2-week canary in staging -> run eval set (automated) -> collect token-cost, latency, top-1 functional regressions, false-positive completions. If pass, schedule dedicated-reserved demo pricing and SLA review.

Open questions / unknowns:
- How deterministic is output across quantized kernels? Need engineering note on kernel selection stability.
- Can Redwood provide a reproducible artifact (model+inference-config bundle) for customer archival?

Related tickets/threads: INF-3421 (config drift on quantization), INF-3498 (canary telemetry missing spans).

Stated next immediate step: "Start canary with model v2.3 pinned, run eval gate; we want telemetry by EOD week 1."
